heading: Ways we can work together
intro: Everything here is shaped around you rather than pre-determined. Some people want the whole path; others come for integration or spiritual exploration. We decide together, and move when you feel ready.
feesBody: Fees are discussed openly in our first conversation, so there are no surprises and nothing to work out on your own. If cost is what stands between you and reaching out, say so — it is worth a conversation.
metaDescription: The supports Becky provides: One-on-One; Couples; Professional Experientials; Integration Only

services.name: Just or You
services.body: We work one-on-one. We work together, paving the way for your new experiences. I recommend 6-8 visits, depending on your goals and availability. This gives us the opportunity to build a connection and deepen your experience.

services.name: Couples
services.body: This support is for couples who are wanting to deepen their connection, and for those hoping to soften some tension for growth and understanding. This support is not currently for couples in crisis.

services.name: Professional Experiential
services.body: This support is for professionals in the mental health, social work, and medical fields. If you are a professional who is curious about this kind of support, you're in the right place. Experience what that buzz is all about. Until you experience it yourself, you will always be moving through a space of mystery, and mystery will always come with apprehension. Let's dispel the mystery together.

services.name: Integration Only
services.body: Integration is where the lasting growth happens, it's the most important part of the journey. This support is for those who are actively engaged in high-level (IV, IM) Ketamine treatment through a local Ketamine clinic. These clinics do not provide integration, but I do, I'm happy to provide just the integration phase of the support.
